title: Starship and futuristic planet locations
content: My most vivid dreams consistently take place in a far-future environment. It's been like that for 15+ years with at least 1 dream of this kind every few days. One is a starship with large windows, traveling through a mysterious deep space. Sometimes it lands on planets (there are never any aliens on those, but there were robots a couple times). The other is like a starship-prequel: an impressive futuristic city on Earth or a similar planet. I'm usually aware of being a scientist or astronaut, who is about to leave on the space journey. I have vivid emotions of excitement and trepidation about it. Then after waking up, I often have this odd sense of longing. Like that world is lost to me, at least while I have to be awake. It's strange, because IRL I don't normally read/watch or think about sci-fi type stuff. I am more into magical "medieval" fantasy. I wonder if there are others out there with interstellar travel dream worlds?
